title: Holder launch result (laptop, internal)
description: A launcher's answer to a launch request, <state folder>\board-holder-launch.<hex>.result.json (D30): the holder it started, or why it started none. Internal: written by the launcher, read and removed by the keeper pass that made the request. Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). See docs/state.md, "A holder's launch files".

process_started_at.description: The holder's creation time, UTC, truncated to the millisecond.

command_line.description: The holder's command line, as read back from the process, or null when it could not be read.
